claim: In the matching retail DLL, Referee.UpdateRefereeAnm (0x06005097) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 415-byte body. It returns immediately when isAnmPause is nonzero. When reqAnmInit is nonzero, it sets CurrentSkill from SkillDataMan.inst.GetSkillData_Standard(SkillID), CurrentAnmIdx=0, isAnmBoot=1, currentFormIdx=-1, copies CurrentSkill.anmType into Referee.anmType, sets FormDispDuration=0, loads CurrentSkill.anmData[CurrentAnmIdx], copies terrainColType into TerrainColType and anmEndState into AnimeEnd, then clears reqAnmInit. The shared update path reloads that animation-data element. When FormDispDuration is nonpositive and currentFormIdx is not less than formNum-1, currentFormIdx is reset to -1. Only when FormDispDuration is zero does the method increment currentFormIdx and call GetCurrentFormDispInfo, repeatedly advancing currentFormIdx while the returned dispFrm is zero. From the first returned record with nonzero dispFrm it stores FormDispDuration=dispFrm, reads centerPos.x into a local and the negation of centerPos.y into another; when raw PlDir is 3 or greater it additionally negates the x local. It adds those locals to PlPos.x and PlPos.y, copies flags into FormRev, and when seID is nonzero calls the already-canonical MatchMisc.PlayRefereeSE(seID). The shared tail subtracts one from FormDispDuration and returns. FACT-0069 pins the direct UpdateRefereeAnm call at InitRound IL+0x00C9.
